# SaaS API — operations

17 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `saas-api.allow-attach-rebilling` — **Allow Attach Rebilling** — `POST /saas/allow-attach-rebilling/{locationId}` (write, agency)
  Marks a SaaS sub-account as awaiting rebilling attach and optionally stores the rebilling configuration that should be applied when the rebilling config is created.
- `saas-api.bulk-disable-saas` — **Disable SaaS for locations** — `POST /saas/bulk-disable-saas/{companyId}` (write, agency)
  Disable SaaS for locations for given locationIds
- `saas-api.bulk-enable-saas` — **Bulk Enable SaaS** — `POST /saas/bulk-enable-saas/{companyId}` (write, agency)
  Enable SaaS mode for multiple locations with support for both SaaS v1 and v2
- `saas-api.enable-saas-location` — **Enable SaaS for Sub-Account (Formerly Location)** — `POST /saas/enable-saas/{locationId}` (write, agency)
  Enable SaaS for Sub-Account (Formerly Location) based on the data provided :::info This feature is only available on Agency Pro ($497) plan.
- `saas-api.generate-payment-link` — **Update SaaS subscription** — `PUT /saas/update-saas-subscription/{locationId}` (write, agency)
  Update SaaS subscription for given locationId and customerId
- `saas-api.get-agency-plans` — **Get Agency Plans** — `GET /saas/agency-plans/{companyId}` (read, agency)
  Fetch all agency subscription plans for a given company ID
- `saas-api.get-location-subscription` — **Get Location Subscription Details** — `GET /saas/get-saas-subscription/{locationId}` (read, agency)
  Fetch subscription details for a specific location from location metadata
- `saas-api.get-location-wallet-balance` — **Get Location Wallet Balance** — `GET /saas/companies/{companyId}/locations/{locationId}/wallet-balance` (read, agency)
  Fetch the wallet balance for a specific location.
- `saas-api.get-saas-locations` — **Get SaaS Locations** — `GET /saas/saas-locations/{companyId}` (read, agency)
  Fetch all SaaS-activated locations for a company with pagination
- `saas-api.get-saas-plan` — **Get SaaS Plan** — `GET /saas/saas-plan/{planId}` (read, agency)
  Fetch a specific SaaS plan by plan ID
- `saas-api.list-agency-wallet-transactions` — **List agency wallet transactions** — `POST /saas/companies/{companyId}/wallet-transactions` (write, agency)
  Fetch paginated wallet transactions for an agency (company).
- `saas-api.list-location-wallet-transactions` — **List location wallet transactions** — `POST /saas/locations/{locationId}/wallet-transactions` (write, agency)
  Fetch paginated wallet transactions for a sub-account (location).
- `saas-api.locations` — **Get locations by stripeId with companyId** — `GET /saas/locations` (read, agency)
  Get locations by stripeCustomerId or stripeSubscriptionId with companyId
- `saas-api.pause-location` — **Pause location** — `POST /saas/pause/{locationId}` (write, agency)
  Pause Sub account for given locationId
- `saas-api.remove-attached-config` — **Remove attached config** — `POST /saas/remove-attached-config/{locationId}` (write, agency)
  Clears attached SaaS plan (attachPlanId/attachPriceId) and/or attached rebilling config from a sub-account in setup_pending, and sets suspendedInfo.payment_pending to false.
- `saas-api.update-location-wallet-balance` — **Update Location Wallet Balance** — `POST /saas/companies/{companyId}/locations/{locationId}/wallet-balance/complimentary-credits` (write, agency)
  Update the wallet balance or complimentary credit settings for a specific location.
- `saas-api.update-rebilling` — **Update Rebilling** — `POST /saas/update-rebilling/{companyId}` (write, agency)
  Bulk update rebilling for given locationIds
